scope.note: Remote default main fetched successfully. Svelte implementation, examples and fixes reviewed with their core/API/CI dependencies; earlier historical experiments are inventoried and their existing evidence retained, not freshly audited.

findings.behavior: Throwing host cleanup or URL startup leaves no internal connection/key/DOM claim; teardown continues and host cleanup errors become safe diagnostics. Renderer still rejects its returned Promise for injected View cleanup failure after releasing DOM.
Foreign or disposed reaction owners rejected before graph mutation; active same-Store cross-Scope ownership retained.
Automatic Registry and Runtime share supplied CEL functions.
Persisted page transitions retain live State, same DOM and Actions; final exit disposes.

clarifications.decision: Document existing code Component contract/adapter and ID-kind compatibility preconditions. Do not reject every unknown ID: resourceResolver may legally add declarative Components in an execution Registry fork.
